title: Cyber incident disables Pacific Blue Cross systems and website
date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its publication day, 27 November.
geo_basis: The page read does not state a city; placed at country level (Canada)
impact: One claimant told Vista Radio they had to pay cash for prescriptions because the system was shut down, according to My Prince George Now
summary: My Prince George Now reports that Pacific Blue Cross systems and its website are down after a cyber incident. The article says the company stated on its website that it is working with external specialists to investigate the extent of the incident and to securely restore services. It gives no restoration estimate and does not say whether data was taken.
plain: Pacific Blue Cross says a cyber incident has taken its systems and website offline. It is working with external specialists to restore services securely, the report says.
exec: A cyber incident has disabled Pacific Blue Cross systems and website; the report gives no restoration time.
action: Pacific Blue Cross asks people to keep their receipts and any plan administrative requests, which can be submitted and will be processed once the outage is resolved.

sources.name: My Prince George Now: Cyber incident disables Pacific Blue Cross systems and website

validation.note: Only My Prince George Now was read, relaying the company's website statement. Vancouver Sun and CBC reports exist but could not be read (CBC answered 403, Vancouver Sun was not fetchable); pac.bluecross.ca answered 503.

review.note: stronger than source: removed claims-cannot-be-processed and provider wording not on page; impact now the claimant cash payment; location lowered to country
